```{r}
library(polars)

# Leitura dos arquivos TSV 
basics <- pl$read_csv(
  "title.basics0.tsv.gz", 
  separator = "\t", 
  null_values = "\\N"
)

ratings <- pl$read_csv(
  "title.ratings.tsv.gz", 
  separator = "\t", 
  null_values = "\\N"
)

principals <- pl$read_csv(
  "title.principals0.tsv.gz", 
  separator = "\t", 
  null_values = "\\N"
)
```

```{r}
# 1.
top5_filmes <- basics$
  filter(pl$col("titleType") == "movie")$
  join(ratings, on = "tconst", how = "inner")$
  sort("averageRating", "numVotes", descending = c(TRUE, TRUE))$head(5)$
  select("tconst", "primaryTitle", "averageRating", "numVotes")

print(top5_filmes)
```

```{r}
# 2.
genero_popular <- ratings$
  filter(pl$col("averageRating") > 8)$
  join(
    basics$filter(pl$col("titleType") == "movie"), 
    on = "tconst", 
    how = "inner"
  )$filter(pl$col("genres")$is_not_null())$
  with_columns(pl$col("genres")$str$split(","))$
  explode("genres")$
  group_by("genres")$agg(pl$len()$alias("frequencia"))$
  sort("frequencia", descending = TRUE)$
  head(1)

print(genero_popular)
```

```{r}
# 3.
top_atores <- ratings$
  filter(pl$col("averageRating") > 7.5)$
  join(
    basics$filter(pl$col("titleType") == "movie"), 
    on = "tconst", 
    how = "inner"
  )$
  join(principals, on = "tconst", how = "inner")$
  filter((pl$col("category") == "actor") | (pl$col("category") == "actress"))$
  group_by("nconst")$agg(pl$len()$alias("total_filmes"))$
  sort("total_filmes", descending = TRUE)$
  head(3)

print(top_atores)
```
